description: ASTRAVA is a team of passionate student innovators exploring space science, technology, and data-driven solutions to real-world challenges. We aim to combine creativity, collaboration, and problem-solving to turn ideas into meaningful solutions for Earth and beyond. We welcome curious minds, fresh perspectives, and a shared passion for innovation.
summary:
ASTROCARE – AI-Powered Astronaut Health Monitoring Platform

ASTROCARE is an AI-powered platform developed to address the major health challenges faced by astronauts during space missions. Astronauts experience several health risks, including bone loss, muscle weakness, radiation exposure, sleep disorders and mental stress due to the space environment.

We developed a web-based platform that analyses multiple health indicators together, such as heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen levels, bone density, muscle strength, sleep quality and radiation exposure. It identifies unusual health patterns, detects potential risks early, displays health trends and provides personalised preventive suggestions.

The platform aims to move beyond monitoring individual health parameters by understanding how different health factors may affect one another. It supports early risk awareness and helps astronauts take preventive measures.

ASTROCARE is important because maintaining astronaut health is essential for mission safety, performance and long-duration space exploration. Our goal is to make astronaut health monitoring smarter, more integrated and preventive.
details:
ASTROCARE is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring platform designed to address health challenges during space missions. It monitors multiple health indicators, including heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen levels, bone density, muscle strength, sleep quality, mental stress and radiation exposure.

Our platform analyses these indicators together to identify unusual patterns, detect potential health risks early and provide personalised preventive suggestions. It also helps visualise health trends and supports better health awareness.

We developed ASTROCARE using HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with AI-assisted development tools. The project focuses on combining multiple health indicators rather than monitoring each one separately.

ASTROCARE aims to improve astronaut well-being, support preventive healthcare and contribute to safer, longer-duration space missions.
